entity.summary: Active cryptocurrency exchange and payments platform that says it began in 2017 as a P2P digital-currency exchange and currently offers cryptocurrency buy, sell and trading services across multiple assets including Lisk.
entity.notes: First-party About material states that Bitmama started in 2017 as a P2P digital currency exchange. The current first-party site offers buy, sell and trade services and lists Lisk among supported cryptocurrencies. January 1 is a year-level marker only because the reviewed first-party source establishes 2017 rather than an exact launch day. The separate Lisk Chain shutdown dependency does not change Bitmama's entity status at this checkpoint.
